evidence.moatW: セグメント別売上(FY2025・百万USD、10-K MD&A セグメント別 Total segment revenue): Global Business Solutions 11,077=58.8% / Consumer 4,870=25.9% / Credit Karma 2,263=12.0% / ProTax 621=3.3%、合計18,831。≥15%は Global Business Solutions(QuickBooks+Mailchimp) と Consumer(TurboTax) の**2本**。両者は顧客(中小・中堅企業 vs 個人納税者)、競合(会計/給与/決済ベンダー vs 税務申告事業者・IRS Direct File)、季節性(通年 vs 1-4月)、規制(税制改正・公的無償化の直撃を受けるのはConsumer側)が別で、片方が折れても他方が残る＝独立。同一の設置基盤・同一の中核エンジンに乗る関係ではない(v9.9.41の1本化条件に非該当)。Credit Karma 12.0%・ProTax 3.3%は15%閾値未満で本数に算入しない。顧客集中は10-K『No customer accounted for 10% or more of total net revenue for the twelve months ended July 31, 2025, 2024 or 2023』。→ moatW=85(据置)。出典: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/896878/000089687825000035/intu-20250731.htm
evidence.dom: 自社シェア%: **原本(FY2025 10-K)に開示なし**／上位N社合計%: 同じく開示なし。ただし提出書類自身が市場構造をfragmentedと明言 → 残余の刻み50で確定(v9.9.41規約3)。原文: 『We face intense competition in all aspects of our businesses across all of our offerings. Competition is rapidly evolving, **fragmented**, and involves complex interdependencies with many businesses.』『Our competitors may … have greater technical, marketing, and other resources, have greater brand recognition, **have larger installed bases of customers**』(Item 1 COMPETITION)。競合の列挙も業種横断で9カテゴリに散る(business software providers / 私営・公的な税務申告事業者 / 会計・税務事務所 / 決済・銀行 / 個人財務管理 / 金融商品マーケットプレイス / 金融機関 / 信用情報機関 / プラットフォーム企業)。→ 自社が40%以上を占める市場構造とは提出書類自身が述べていない = dom 50。出典: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/896878/000089687825000035/intu-20250731.htm
evidence.irr: 70=高摩擦移行困難。『because we have created an ecosystem where customers can have one identity across multiple Intuit products』『Through seamless onboarding and automated transaction reconciliation, our payment processing solutions are deeply integrated into our QuickBooks Online, Desktop, and Intuit Enterprise Suite offerings』=会計・決済・給与が同一IDで結合し移行摩擦が高い。加えて『developing consumer and professional tax software and services presents unique challenges because of the demanding development cycle required to accurately incorporate federal and state tax law and tax form changes within a rigid timetable』=税法追随の工程負荷が新規代替の障壁。ただし規格認証による排他ロックは無く、『increased competition from providers of free and low cost offerings, particularly in our tax, accounting, payments and consumer finance platform businesses』と自認するため85は不可→70。出典: FY2025 Form 10-K Item 1/Item 1A https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/896878/000089687825000035/intu-20250731.htm
evidence.rep: 80=極困難。『Intuit Inc. was incorporated in California in March 1984』から40年超の蓄積で『Serving approximately 100 million consumers, small and mid-market businesses, and accountants worldwide』。『We have a significant competitive advantage with our scale of data, data services, AI capabilities, ecosystem of applications, and our large network of AI-enabled human experts』。研究開発費は Research and development 2,928/2,754/2,539百万USD(FY2025/24/23、3年で$8.2B)、加えて買収 acq5=$9.1十億。他方『our competitors ... have larger installed bases of customers, have well-established relationships with our current and potential customers』と同型競合の実在を自認するため100(複製不能)は不可→80。出典: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/896878/000089687825000035/intu-20250731.htm
evidence.dur: 75=スイッチングコスト。堀の機構は会計・決済・給与データの固着。『we have created an ecosystem where customers can have one identity across multiple Intuit products』『our payment processing solutions are deeply integrated into our QuickBooks Online, Desktop, and Intuit Enterprise Suite offerings』。『Online ecosystem average revenue per customer ... increased 14%』に対し『Online ecosystem paying customers ... increased 5%』=既存顧客への積み増しが成長の主源=固着の実測。会計士チャネル(『serves ... the accounting professionals who assist and advise them』)は補助機構でありネットワーク(85)を主機構と断ずる原本根拠が無いため75。規制/物理(100)・ブランド(55)は該当せず。出典: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/896878/000089687825000035/intu-20250731.htm
